courses.title: From zero… to pro
courses.intro: Five courses. Each one starts from the basics and ends with real projects. Pick your path.

labels.askText: Hello Nahdet Sham, I have a question about a course

python.title: Python: From Zero to Pro
python.hook: Levels 1 and 2, graphical interfaces, databases and real projects
modules: Programming fundamentals in depth, from your first line of code
Object-oriented programming (OOP), the way companies do it
Desktop apps with graphical interfaces (GUI)
SQL databases connected to your programs
Automating tasks and working with files
Real projects for your portfolio
projects: Library management system with a GUI and a database
python.outcome: You build complete programs with a graphical interface and a database

frontend.title: Front-End & React: From Zero to Pro
frontend.hook: Design and build real websites and React apps, all the way to launch
modules: Professional websites with HTML5 and CSS3
Responsive design for every screen
Modern JavaScript (ES6+) from scratch
Interactive sites connected to real APIs
React: components, Hooks and state
Git and GitHub, and publishing your site
projects: React store with a shopping cart
frontend.outcome: You build responsive websites and React apps and publish them online

backend.title: Back-End with Node.js & Express
backend.hook: Build the server that runs apps from the inside
modules: Strong servers with Node.js and Express
REST APIs designed to company standards
MongoDB and SQL databases
Login, permissions and JWT security
Professional testing with Postman
Deploy your server and run it online
backend.outcome: You build a real API connected to a database and deploy it

ai.title: Machine Learning & Deep Learning
ai.hook: Teach the computer to learn from data
modules: Analyse data and uncover its patterns with Pandas
Machine learning algorithms, from idea to application
Neural networks and deep learning
Computer vision: image classification with CNNs
Text processing and sentiment analysis (NLP)
AI models with TensorFlow and PyTorch
ai.outcome: You train machine learning and deep learning models and evaluate their results

excel.title: Excel, Power Pivot & Power BI: From Zero to Pro
modules: Master Excel from the first cell
Powerful formulas: XLOOKUP and IF
Pivot Tables and data cleaning with Power Query
Data models and relationships with Power Pivot
Interactive dashboards that impress management
Power BI and DAX for professional reports
excel.outcome: You analyse real data and build interactive dashboards
